customer_job: Resolve an explicitly declared API version selector and the operation matched by one captured request against one OpenAPI document.

openapi_json.description: OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 JSON; no refs or server URL fetch.

path.description: Absolute path only; do not include query or fragment.

headers.description: Header names match case-insensitively. Values are never echoed.

value.description: Absolute path prefix, matched on segment boundary.

outputs.route.allowed_methods: Sorted methods when a matching path lacks the requested method.
outputs.route.matched_operation: Method, OpenAPI path template, operationId, and summary; null when no unique operation is selected.
outputs.privacy: Raw request query/header values are not returned.

errors.400: Malformed input, unsupported OpenAPI, invalid method/path/template, or unsupported selector.
errors.413: Input, pair count, selector count, path count, operation count, JSON node, or nesting limit exceeded.

integration.registration: Central integrator should adapt the export to the existing Worker router and existing x402 route middleware; do not create a parallel payment flow.
integration.discovery: Before publication, register the real input/output schema, example, and caveats in the existing OpenAPI/MCP discovery surfaces.
integration.payment_verification: Confirm actual live HTTP 402 price, network, asset, and payTo from the integrated route; price candidate is $0.005 USDC only.
integration.deployment: No individual Worker, route, deployment permission, or PayAPI quota slot has been assigned. This manifest does not authorize deployment or submission.

distinctness.engineer_29: Compares two OpenAPI documents and reports directional breaking changes; this endpoint inspects one request against one document and caller-declared selectors.
distinctness.engineer_42: Analyzes Accept/vendor-media-type negotiation; this endpoint does not interpret Accept.
